svg.title: SO-101 and MX Keys: measured fixture layout
svg.desc: Top view. X points from the robot toward the keyboard; Y points left. D is the centre of the front base face projected onto the plastic underside plane. Q, P and Z are the measured keycap rim centres.
svg.text: SO-101 → MX Keys | bird’s-eye measurement map
Model projection • dimensions in millimetres • not a print-to-scale alignment template
Expected keycap rim centres relative to D (X, Y, Z mm)
K = keyboard CAD origin (not a ruler datum)
D in robot CAD frame: (64.635, 0.000, -2.400) mm
Z = height above the plastic base underside plane.
Clamp/table height is not automatically this zero plane.
Q/P/Z: centre of the key outline at its top rim, keys released; not the recessed bowl.
Fit consistency is not physical validation. Match the base shape and follow FIXTURE_SETUP.md.
